diagnostics.title: Anonymous diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Share anonymous reliability counts. Personal and game data are never sent.

privacy.card_desc: Local data, browser sessions, and optional diagnostics.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body_one: EMMM stores settings, local mod metadata, Discover bookmarks and history, restored tab addresses, and download records on this device. This data remains local unless you enable an optional sharing feature.
privacy.body_two: Discover uses a separate browser profile for website sessions. EMMM does not read or transmit website passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, or form contents.
privacy.body_three: Anonymous diagnostics are optional. When enabled, EMMM sends its release, limited operation and outcome codes, aggregate durations, and short diagnostic codes to Grafana Cloud. Paths, mod or game names, URLs, messages, website data, and user identifiers are excluded. Crash reports require confirmation. Disabling diagnostics clears the local queue.

terms.card_desc: Responsibilities for games, mods, and external tools.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body_one: EMMM is an independent third-party utility. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any game developer, publisher, or platform.
terms.body_two: Use EMMM only with games, mods, accounts, and content you are permitted to use. You are responsible for following the terms and rules of each game, platform, website, and third-party tool.
terms.body_three: External downloads and tools operate outside EMMM. Review files and keep backups before making changes. EMMM does not endorse or guarantee third-party content.
